def VTask.log : (b n : ℕ) -> ℕ :=
match b, n with
| _, 0 => 0
| 0, _ => 0
| 1, _ => 0
| _, 1 => 0
| b, n =>
  let rec go k := do
    if b ^ k ≤ n then go (k + 1)
    else return k - 1
  go 0
